sentences.en: By the year 2050, nearly 80% of the Earth's population will live in urban centres.
sentences.zh: 到 2050 年,地球上近 80% 的人口将居住在城市中心。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Applying the most conservative estimates to current demographic trends, the human population will increase by about three billion people by then.
sentences.zh: 对当前的人口趋势应用最保守的估计,届时人口将增加约30亿人。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: An estimated 10% hectares of new land (about 20% larger than Brazil) will be needed to grow enough food to feed them if traditional farming methods continue as they are practised today.
sentences.zh: 如果传统耕作方法继续沿用至今,预计将需要 10% 公顷的新土地（比巴西大约 20%）来种植足够的粮食来养活它们。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: At present, throughout the world.
sentences.zh: 目前,全世界范围内。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: over 80% of the land that is suitable for raising crops is in use.
sentences.zh: 80%以上适合种植农作物的土地已得到利用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Historically, some 15% of that has been laid waste by poor management practices.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看,其中约 15% 的资源因管理不当而被浪费。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: What can be done to ensure enough food for the world's population to live on?
sentences.zh: 可以采取哪些措施来确保世界人口有足够的食物生存？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The concept of indoor farming is not new, since hothouse production of tomatoes and other produce has been in vogue for some time.
sentences.zh: 室内农业的概念并不新鲜,因为西红柿和其他农产品的温室生产已经流行了一段时间。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: What is new is the urgent need to scale up this technology to accommodate another three billion people.
sentences.zh: 新的情况是迫切需要扩大这项技术以容纳另外 30 亿人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Many believe an entirely new approach to indoor farming is required, employing cutting-edge technologies.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为需要采用尖端技术的全新室内农业方法。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: One such proposal is for the 'Vertical Farm".
sentences.zh: 其中一项提案是“垂直农场”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The concept is of multi-storey buildings in which food crops are grown in environmentally controlled conditions.
sentences.zh: 这个概念是多层建筑,其中粮食作物在环境受控的条件下种植。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Situated in the heart of urban centres, they would drastically reduce the amount of transportation required to bring food to consumers.
sentences.zh: 位于城市中心的中心地带,它们将大大减少将食品运送给消费者所需的交通量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Vertical farms would need to be efficient, cheap to construct and safe to operate.
sentences.zh: 垂直农场需要高效、建造成本低且运营安全。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: If successfully implemented, proponents claim, vertical farms offer the promise of urban renewal, sustainable production of a safe and varied food supply (through year-round production of all crops), and the eventual repair of ecosystems that have been sacrificed for horizontal farming.
sentences.zh: 支持者声称,如果成功实施,垂直农场将带来城市更新、可持续生产安全且多样化的食品供应（通过全年生产所有农作物）以及最终修复因水平农业而牺牲的生态系统。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: It took humans 10,000 years to learn how to grow most of the crops we now take for granted.
sentences.zh: 人类花了一万年的时间才学会如何种植我们现在认为理所当然的大部分农作物。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Along the way, we despoiled most of the land we worked, often turning verdant, natural ecozones into semi-arid deserts.
sentences.zh: 一路上,我们掠夺了大部分我们耕种的土地,常常把翠绿的自然生态区变成半干旱的沙漠。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Within that same time frame, we evolved into an urban species, in which 60% of the human population now lives vertically in cities.
sentences.zh: 在同一时间范围内,我们进化成了城市物种,其中 60% 的人口现在垂直生活在城市中。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: This means that, for the majority, we humans have shelter from the elements, yet we subject our food-bearing plants to the rigours of the great outdoors and can do no more than hope for a good weather year.
sentences.zh: 这意味着,对于大多数人来说,我们人类拥有躲避自然的庇护,但我们却让我们的粮食植物经受着户外的严酷考验,除了希望有一个好天气之外,我们什么也做不了。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, more often than not now, due to a rapidly changing climate, that is not what happens.
sentences.zh: 然而,由于气候迅速变化,现在情况往往并非如此。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Massive floods, long droughts, hurricanes and severe monsoons take their toll each year, destroying millions of tons of valuable crops.
sentences.zh: 大规模洪水、长期干旱、飓风和严重季风每年都会造成人员伤亡,毁坏数百万吨有价值的农作物。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The supporters of vertical farming claim many potential advantages for the system.
sentences.zh: 垂直农业的支持者声称该系统有许多潜在的优势。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For instance, crops would be produced all year round, as they would be kept in artificially controlled, optimum growing conditions.
sentences.zh: 例如,农作物将全年生产,因为它们将保持在人工控制的最佳生长条件下。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: There would be no weather-related crop failures due to droughts, floods or pests.
sentences.zh: 不会因干旱、洪水或虫害而导致与天气相关的农作物歉收。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: All the food could be grown organically, eliminating the need for herbicides, pesticides and fertilisers.
sentences.zh: 所有食物都可以有机种植,无需使用除草剂、杀虫剂和化肥。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The system would greatly reduce the incidence of many infectious diseases that are acquired at the agricultural interface.
sentences.zh: 该系统将大大减少在农业界面获得的许多传染病的发病率。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Although the system would consume energy, it would return energy to the grid via methane generation from composting non-edible parts of plants.
sentences.zh: 虽然该系统会消耗能量,但它会通过植物的非食用部分堆肥产生甲烷,将能量返回电网。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It would also dramatically reduce fossil fuel use, by cutting out the need for tractors, ploughs and shipping.
sentences.zh: 它还将消除对拖拉机、犁和运输的需求,从而大幅减少化石燃料的使用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A major drawback of vertical farming, however, is that the plants would require artificial light.
sentences.zh: 然而,垂直农业的一个主要缺点是植物需要人造光。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Without it, those plants nearest the windows would be exposed to more sunlight and grow more quickly, reducing the efficiency of the system.
sentences.zh: 如果没有它,那些最靠近窗户的植物将暴露在更多的阳光下并生长得更快,从而降低系统的效率。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Single storey greenhouses have the benefit of natural overhead light: even so.
sentences.zh: 单层温室具有自然顶光的好处：即便如此。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: many still need artificial lighting.
sentences.zh: 许多仍然需要人工照明。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A multi-storey facility with no natural overhead light would require far more.
sentences.zh: 没有自然顶光的多层设施需要更多。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Generating enough light could be prohibitively expensive unless cheap, renewable energy is available, and this appears to be rather a future aspiration than a likelihood for the near future.
sentences.zh: 除非有廉价的可再生能源,否则产生足够的光可能会非常昂贵,而且这似乎只是未来的愿望,而不是不久的将来的可能性。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: One variation on vertical farming that has been developed is to grow plants in stacked trays that move on rails.
sentences.zh: 已开发的垂直农业的一种变体是在轨道上移动的堆叠托盘中种植植物。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Moving the trays allows the plants to get enough sunlight.
sentences.zh: 移动托盘可以让植物获得足够的阳光。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This system is already in operation, and works well within a single-storey greenhouse with light reaching it from above: it is not certain, however, that it can be made to work without that overhead natural light.
sentences.zh: 该系统已经投入运行,并且在光线从上方照射到的单层温室内运行良好：但是,不确定是否可以在没有头顶自然光的情况下运行。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Vertical farming is an attempt to address the undoubted problems that we face in producing enough food for a growing population.
sentences.zh: 垂直农业是解决我们在为不断增长的人口生产足够食物时所面临的毫无疑问的问题的一种尝试。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: At the moment, though, more needs to be done to reduce the detrimental impact it would have on the environment, particularly as regards the use of energy.
sentences.zh: 然而,目前需要采取更多措施来减少其对环境的不利影响,特别是在能源的使用方面。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: While it is possible that much of our food will be grown in skyscrapers in future, most experts currently believe it is far more likely that we will simply use the space available on urban rooftops.
sentences.zh: 虽然未来我们的大部分食物可能会在摩天大楼中种植,但大多数专家目前认为我们更有可能只是使用城市屋顶上的可用空间。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

questions.title: Questions 1-13
instructions: Questions 8-13: Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage?

items.prompt: Some food plants, including…., are already grown indoors
Vertical farms would be located in…., meaning that there would be less need to take them long distances to customers
Vertical farms could use methane from plants and animals to produce….
The consumption of….would be cut because agricultural vehicles would be unnecessary.
The fact that vertical farms would need…light is a disadvantage
One form of vertical farming involves planting in…which are not fixed.
The most probable development is that food will be grown on… in towns and cities
Methods for predicting the Earth‟s population have recently changed
Human beings are responsible for some of the destruction to food-producing land.
The crops produced in vertical farms will depend on the season.
Some damage to food crops is caused by climate change.
Fertilisers will be needed for certain crops in vertical farms.
Vertical farming will make plants less likely to be affected by infectious diseases.
